description: The register of publisher prefixes under https://w3id.org/battinfo/ (IDENTIFIER_POLICY.md 6.4). A publisher mints records under id/{prefix}/ when records is true, and defines its own terms under def/{prefix}/. resolver is where the publisher's addresses are served, or null when the BattINFO registry dispatches them. landing is the host of the publisher's own record pages, or null; a browser that opens one of its record IRIs is sent to the record's page only when that page is on this host. Validated by prefixes.schema.json.
